references.text: Zanoah is also mentioned here as a city in the hill country of Judah, showing that there were two cities with the same name in Judah—one in the lowlands and one in the hills.
Zanoah is mentioned in connection with the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls after the exile, where the people from Zanoah helped with the work.
Zanoah is mentioned as a place where the descendants of Judah settled after returning from Babylon.
Tappuah is mentioned as a Canaanite king who was defeated by Joshua, and the city is referred to in several places as a border town.
Another city called Tappuah is mentioned in the hill country of Judah.
Tappuah is mentioned as a border town between the tribal territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.
